Method of Attack: The package compromises any computer that has it installed or running, potentially giving full control to an outside entity. It may embed malicious code (CWE-506). All secrets and keys stored on the compromised computer should be rotated immediately. Removing the package does not guarantee removal of all malicious software.
Impacted Systems: Any computer with the package installed or running
Attack Vector: Installation of the malicious npm package bender-event-definition-loader
